title: First-Month Routes
subtitle: Scanned signals, planned exits, and one route at a time
summary: The first month is about controlled exploration. Scan a signal, read its field guide entry, track one HoloMap marker, and return before pushing deeper.
body: Do not chase every marker the moment it appears. Survivor caches and open ruins are early routes; toxic swamps, reactor ruins, and data centers are warnings until counterplay exists.
A good route has five checks: a known signal, a readable risk label, a reward reason, a prep list, and a return path.
Terminal What Now should point to the active route desk after your first-week loop is stable.
